scope: Replay two existing user speech recordings, execute ROS lamp commands, then speak matching Arabic acknowledgements

initial_failure_and_repair.failure: The first attempt stopped on ModuleNotFoundError for course204.spoken_replies before any ROS request or audio playback.
initial_failure_and_repair.repair: Registered the current project with --no-deps -e . in the recognition environment, verified cache and CLI imports, then repeated the announced ON/OFF tests.

covered: Reply follows a matching successful physical ROS acknowledgement
Failed, mismatched or simulated acknowledgement does not speak success
ROS exception does not trigger audio
Playback failure is reported separately from successful device control
Missing, corrupted or mismatched reply cache is rejected

limits: This test reused earlier recordings; fresh voice-to-ROS behavior was separately validated before adding replies.
Only the two fixed Arabic acknowledgement phrases were generated and tested.
Wake-word detection, continuous listening, weather and date replies are not implemented by this change.
Pi 4 and reboot persistence remain untested for this configuration.
No private speech recordings or model binaries were published.
